history.summary: A 495 sqft 1BR freehold shoebox in D05 Pasir Panjang (Parc Imperial, TOP 2010) at $820k / $1,657 PSF — well below the $1,757 URA median, just 300m from Haw Par Villa MRT. The fatal flaw: a reliable 36-transaction base shows the development has appreciated only 0.41%/yr, essentially flat for over a decade.
history.rating_rationale: Parc Imperial looks cheap (asking $1,657 PSF vs $1,757 median) and the 300m MRT walk plus freehold tenure are genuine positives, but the dominant fact is the 0.41%/yr appreciation on a robust 36-transaction base — the development has been effectively dead money for years, and the low PSF reflects that persistent weakness rather than a bargain. A 495 sqft shoebox 1BR is the narrowest buyer segment, the weak arena record (92-220, Elo 898) is the worst in the batch, and there is no catalyst to reverse the flat trajectory. For a 5-7yr investment hold this is an avoid despite the low quantum.
red_flags: 0.41%/yr appreciation on a reliable 36-txn base — effectively flat for over a decade
Worst arena record in batch (92-220-3, Elo 898)
Low PSF reflects chronic underperformance, not a bargain
catalysts: Freehold and 300m to Haw Par Villa MRT supports steady rental occupancy
Low $820k quantum keeps entry friction and ABSD base low

history.summary: Freehold 1BR (495sqft) at Pasir Panjang Rd, D05, near Pasir Panjang/Haw Par Villa Circle Line MRT. Asking $1,657 psf is genuinely below the project's recent average — the most credible value of the five.
history.rating_rationale: This is the one case where the algo's 'cheap' read is corroborated by real transactions, not a thin-cohort quirk (psf_cohort_txns=5, appreciation_txns=36). Verified last-12-month range is $1,193-$1,984 psf at avg ~$1,750, with the $1,984 high set by a 398sqft micro-unit; this 495sqft unit at $1,657 psf is ~5% under the average and well inside the band — a real, if modest, discount. District 5 (West Coast/Pasir Panjang corridor) sits in the favorable OCR/RCR forward region per the v3.4 backtest, the opposite of the discredited CCR-prestige prior. Quoted ~5.2% gross rental yield is strong for a freehold shoebox. Tempering factors: built 2010 (old_property flag, 16yrs), shoebox-heavy 138-unit project, and flat trailing appreciation (0.41% CAGR — discount for story only, not a forward guarantee). Net: verified cheap-vs-peers + strong yield + favorable region outweigh the age; a defensible Buy at medium confidence.
red_flags: Shoebox-dominated small project; resale liquidity concentrated in 1BR sub-market
Trailing appreciation near zero (0.41% CAGR) — no momentum tailwind
catalysts: Verified asking PSF (~$1,657) below project 12-month average (~$1,750)
Strong ~5.2% gross rental yield on a freehold shoebox
District 5 OCR/RCR — favorable forward-return region per v3.4 backtest
Circle Line access (Pasir Panjang / Haw Par Villa); Greater Southern Waterfront longer-term upside
